As an orbital welding operator, you will work with various advanced welding processes and contribute to the production of high-quality stainless steel assemblies. Based on technical drawings and production planning, you will independently carry out work orders while ensuring precision and quality throughout the entire process.In this role, you will prepare and process components, perform orbital and TIG welding activities, and work with technologies such as laser welding and laser marking. You will manufacture and assemble stainless steel hoses, couplings, bends, and other complex components using orbital welding heads, welding robots, and manual manipulators.You will also be responsible for performing helium leak tests and final quality inspections to ensure all products meet the highest industry standards. As a maintenance technician, you will work in a large, fully automated distribution centre where technology is constantly in motion. Conveyor systems, roller conveyors, lifts and other automated installations ensure that enormous volumes of goods are moved throughout the warehouse. If a system comes to a standstill, that is where your work becomes interesting: identifying the cause of the problem and getting the system back up and running as quickly as possible.You will work with a broad combination of mechanical engineering, electrical engineering and control technology. One fault may be caused by a mechanical component, while the next may require electrical troubleshooting or analysing the control system. You will look beyond simply replacing a faulty component: you will determine the root cause and identify what is needed to resolve the issue properly.Using advanced monitoring applications, you can see what is happening within the system and systematically identify technical and system-related faults. You will carry out repairs and maintenance and accurately document significant breakdowns and maintenance activities.It is precisely this combination that makes the role so interesting: rather than working on a single machine, you will work with an entire automated system in which different technologies come together.
